-- What a client importing `Spec.go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.ApiState` sees of it (generated by etc/gen-interface.py; do not edit).
-- Every declaration also takes the ambient section variables (left out below): the Go semantics
-- (`ext`, `ffi`, `go_gctx`, `sem`, the package's `Assumptions`), `GF`, `hG`, `StorageModel GF`, `AllG GF`.

def mvcc.api.stateOk (s : List EtcdKv) : Prop :=
  s.length ≤ 2 ^ 62 ∧ ∀ (e : EtcdKv), e ∈ s → mvcc.api.kvSortOk e

def mvcc.api.MTxn.pend : mvcc.api.MTxn → List mvcc.Change :=
  match x✝ with
  | mvcc.api.MTxn.read σ => []
  | mvcc.api.MTxn.write σ pend => pend

def mvcc.api.watchLo (σ : mvcc.api.MvccState) (startRev : w64) : Nat :=
  if startRev = W64 0 then List.length σ.log else sint.nat startRev

def mvcc.api.StreamState.cancel (S : mvcc.api.StreamState) (id : w64) : mvcc.api.StreamState :=
  match S.ws !! id with
  | some w => { ws := <[id := { rg := w.rg, fs := w.fs, lo := w.lo, k := w.k, live := false }]>S.ws, closed := S.closed }
  | none => S

def mvcc.api.recvEvs (rs : List mvcc.api.WResp) (id : w64) : List mvcc.EvM :=
  (List.map mvcc.api.WResp.evs (List.filter (fun r => decide (r.id = id)) rs)).flatten

structure mvcc.api.WResp : Type where
  id : w64
  evs : List mvcc.EvM
  rev : w64
  compactRev : w64

def mvcc.api.MvccState.notify (σ : mvcc.api.MvccState) (pend : List mvcc.Change) :
    mvcc.api.MvccState :=
  { log := σ.log, crev := σ.crev, pending := if pend = [] then none else some pend }

theorem mvcc.api.logCh_commitLog (L : mvcc.Log) (p : List mvcc.Change) : mvcc.logCh (mvcc.commitLog
    L p) = mvcc.logCh (L ++ [p])

def mvcc.api.MTxn.readRev : mvcc.api.MTxn → w64 :=
  match x✝ with
  | mvcc.api.MTxn.read σ => W64 ↑σ.rev
  | mvcc.api.MTxn.write σ pend => W64 ↑(mvcc.writeRev σ.log pend)

def mvcc.api.MvccState.commitPending (σ : mvcc.api.MvccState) : mvcc.api.MvccState :=
  { log := mvcc.commitLog σ.log (σ.pending.getD []), crev := σ.crev, pending := none }

def mvcc.api.mvccN : Namespace :=
  nroot.@"mvcc"

theorem mvcc.api.MvccState.notify_notifiedLog (σ : mvcc.api.MvccState) (p : List mvcc.Change) :
    (σ.notify p).notifiedLog = mvcc.commitLog σ.log p

structure mvcc.api.MvccState : Type where
  log : mvcc.Log
  crev : Int
  pending : Option (List mvcc.Change)

def mvcc.api.wsStart : mvcc.api.StreamState :=
  { ws := ∅, closed := false }

def mvcc.api.MvccState.rev (σ : mvcc.api.MvccState) : Nat :=
  List.length σ.log - 1

structure mvcc.api.WInfo : Type where
  rg : mvcc.WatchRange
  fs : List (mvcc.EvM → Bool)
  lo : Nat
  k : Nat
  live : Bool

def mvcc.api.onceUpTo (L : mvcc.Log) (lo : Nat) (c : Int) : Prop :=
  ∀ (r : Nat), lo ≤ r → ↑r ≤ c → (List.map mvcc.Change.key (List.getD L r [])).Nodup

def mvcc.api.kvSortOk (e : EtcdKv) : Prop :=
  0 < sint.Z e.createRev ∧ 0 < sint.Z e.modRev ∧ 0 < sint.Z e.version

def mvcc.api.StreamState.register (S : mvcc.api.StreamState) (id : w64) (w : mvcc.api.WInfo) :
    mvcc.api.StreamState :=
  { ws := <[id := w]>S.ws, closed := S.closed }

structure mvcc.api.StreamState : Type where
  ws : GMap w64 mvcc.api.WInfo
  closed : Bool

inductive mvcc.api.MvccReachable : mvcc.api.MvccState → Prop
  | mvcc.api.MvccReachable.start : mvcc.api.MvccReachable mvcc.api.mvccStart
  | mvcc.api.MvccReachable.notify (σ : mvcc.api.MvccState) (pend : List mvcc.Change) :
      mvcc.api.MvccReachable σ → σ.pending = none → mvcc.LogWf (σ.log ++ [pend]) →
      mvcc.api.MvccReachable (σ.notify pend)
  | mvcc.api.MvccReachable.commit (σ : mvcc.api.MvccState) : mvcc.api.MvccReachable σ →
      mvcc.api.MvccReachable σ.commitPending
  | mvcc.api.MvccReachable.compact (σ : mvcc.api.MvccState) (r : Int) : mvcc.api.MvccReachable σ →
      σ.pending = none → 1 ≤ r → σ.crev < r → r ≤ ↑σ.rev → mvcc.api.MvccReachable (σ.compactTo r)

theorem mvcc.api.reach_logWf (σ : mvcc.api.MvccState) (h : mvcc.api.MvccReachable σ) : mvcc.LogWf'
    σ.log ∧ mvcc.LogWf' σ.notifiedLog

def mvcc.api.wsRecvOk (σ : mvcc.api.MvccState) (S : mvcc.api.StreamState) (rs : List mvcc.api.WResp)
    : Prop :=
  (∀ (r : mvcc.api.WResp),
      r ∈ rs →
        (r.id ≠ W64 (-1) → (S.ws !! r.id).isSome = true) ∧
          (∀ (ev : mvcc.EvM), ev ∈ r.evs → sint.Z ev.kv.modRev ≤ sint.Z r.rev) ∧
            (r.compactRev = W64 0 → sint.nat r.rev < List.length σ.notifiedLog) ∧
              (r.compactRev ≠ W64 0 →
                  r.evs = [] ∧ r.id ≠ W64 (-1) ∧ r.rev = W64 0 ∧ 0 < sint.Z r.compactRev ∧ sint.Z r.compactRev ≤ σ.crev) ∧
                (r.id = W64 (-1) → r.evs = [] ∧ r.compactRev = W64 0 ∧ 1 ≤ sint.Z r.rev) ∧
                  ∀ (ev : mvcc.EvM),
                    ev ∈ r.evs →
                      0 < sint.Z ev.kv.modRev ∧
                        (ev.del = false → 0 < sint.Z ev.kv.createRev ∧ 0 < sint.Z ev.kv.version)) ∧
    (∀ (id : w64) (w : mvcc.api.WInfo),
        S.ws !! id = some w →
          mvcc.api.onceUpTo σ.notifiedLog w.lo σ.crev →
            ∃ hi,
              hi ≤ List.length σ.notifiedLog ∧
                mvcc.api.recvEvs rs id = mvcc.filtered w.fs (mvcc.watchEvents σ.notifiedLog w.rg w.lo hi)) ∧
      (∀ (j : Nat) (r : mvcc.api.WResp) (id : w64) (w : mvcc.api.WInfo),
          rs[j]? = some r →
            r.evs = [] →
              r.compactRev = W64 0 →
                S.ws !! id = some w →
                  mvcc.api.onceUpTo σ.notifiedLog w.lo σ.crev →
                    r.id = id ∨ r.id = W64 (-1) ∧ w.live = true ∧ w.k ≤ j →
                      mvcc.api.recvEvs (List.take (j + 1) rs) id =
                        mvcc.filtered w.fs (mvcc.watchEvents σ.notifiedLog w.rg w.lo (sint.nat r.rev + 1))) ∧
        (∀ (j : Nat) (r : mvcc.api.WResp) (id : w64) (w : mvcc.api.WInfo),
            rs[j]? = some r →
              r.evs = [] →
                r.compactRev = W64 0 →
                  S.ws !! id = some w →
                    r.id = id ∨ r.id = W64 (-1) ∧ w.live = true ∧ w.k ≤ j → ↑w.lo ≤ sint.Z r.rev + 1) ∧
          ∀ (i j : Nat) (y x : mvcc.api.WResp),
            i < j →
              rs[i]? = some y →
                rs[j]? = some x → y.evs = [] → x.evs = [] → x.compactRev = W64 0 → sint.Z y.rev ≤ sint.Z x.rev

def mvcc.api.MvccState.compactTo (σ : mvcc.api.MvccState) (r : Int) : mvcc.api.MvccState :=
  { log := σ.log, crev := r, pending := σ.pending }

def mvcc.api.MvccState.notifiedLog (σ : mvcc.api.MvccState) : mvcc.Log :=
  match σ.pending with
  | none => σ.log
  | some p => σ.log ++ [p]

def mvcc.api.StreamState.close (S : mvcc.api.StreamState) : mvcc.api.StreamState :=
  { ws := S.ws, closed := true }

def mvcc.api.MTxn.readLog : mvcc.api.MTxn → mvcc.Log :=
  match x✝ with
  | mvcc.api.MTxn.read σ => σ.log
  | mvcc.api.MTxn.write σ pend => σ.log ++ [pend]

def mvcc.api.mvccStart : mvcc.api.MvccState :=
  { log := [[], []], crev := -1, pending := none }

inductive mvcc.api.MTxn : Type
  | mvcc.api.MTxn.read (σ : mvcc.api.MvccState) : mvcc.api.MTxn
  | mvcc.api.MTxn.write (σ : mvcc.api.MvccState) (pend : List mvcc.Change) : mvcc.api.MTxn

theorem mvcc.api.logCh_append (L : mvcc.Log) (p : List mvcc.Change) : mvcc.logCh (L ++ [p]) =
    mvcc.logCh L + p.length

def mvcc.api.MTxn.state : mvcc.api.MTxn → mvcc.api.MvccState :=
  match x✝ with
  | mvcc.api.MTxn.read σ => σ
  | mvcc.api.MTxn.write σ pend => σ

theorem mvcc.api.logCh_append_nil (L : mvcc.Log) : mvcc.logCh (L ++ [[]]) = mvcc.logCh L

theorem mvcc.api.pendItems_nil (L : mvcc.Log) : mvcc.pendItems L [] = mvcc.leaseItemsOf
    (mvcc.stateAfter L)
